name: Hotel Pension Huter
beschreibung: The "Hotel Pension Huter" is located in a quiet yet central position in the municipality of Söll in the Wilder Kaiser-Brixental holiday region. The Bergbahn Söll and the access points to the hiking and skiing areas of the SkiWelt can be reached within a few minutes on foot or by ski bus. The house is kept in a traditional Alpine style, with many rooms featuring a balcony and views of the Wilder Kaiser Massiv. The basic amenities include a breakfast buffet, a small wellness area with sauna and steam bath, as well as the option to book half board. The family-run management shapes the quiet and personal atmosphere of the house. Guests can expect solid accommodation with storage facilities for sports equipment, serving as a practical base for activities in summer and winter.
